mapper.sql: select distinct bw_inventory.id, bw_cargo.id as cargo_id, bw_cargo.cargo_name, bw_cargo.cargo_code, bw_cargo.merge_code, bw_cargo.specification, cast(bw_inventory.no as signed) as inventory_no, bw_inventory_batch.batch_no, bw_inventory.unit_id, bw_inventory.init_quantity, bw_inventory.consume_quantity, bw_inventory.available_quantity, bw_inventory.reserve_quantity, bw_inventory_batch.expired_date, bw_inventory.position_id, concat((select group_concat(bw_storage.name separator '-') from bw_storage where find_in_set(bw_storage.id, bw_cargo_position.id_path)), '-', bw_cargo_position.position) as position from bw_inventory left join bw_inventory_batch on bw_inventory_batch.id = bw_inventory.inventory_batch_id left join bw_cargo on bw_cargo.id = bw_inventory.cargo_id left join bw_cargo_position on bw_inventory.position_id = bw_cargo_position.id left join bw_resource_permission on bw_cargo_position.id = bw_resource_permission.resource_id

select.where:
bw_inventory_batch.is_deleted = 0 and bw_cargo.is_deleted = 0 and bw_inventory.is_deleted = 0 and bw_inventory.available_quantity != 0 and bw_cargo_position.is_deleted = 0 and bw_cargo_position.enable = 1
and bw_inventory.inventory_batch_id = #{query.inventoryBatchId}
and bw_inventory.no like concat('%', #{query.inventoryNo}, '%')
and 1 = 2
and bw_inventory.position_id in
#{item}
order by bw_inventory.id desc

mapper.select:
select distinct bw_cargo.id as id, bw_cargo.cargo_name, bw_cargo.merge_code, bw_cargo.specification, bw_inventory_batch.unit_id FROM bw_cargo LEFT JOIN bw_inventory_batch ON bw_inventory_batch.cargo_id = bw_cargo.id
bw_inventory_batch.is_deleted = 0 and bw_cargo.is_deleted = 0 and bw_inventory_batch.is_deleted = 0
and bw_cargo.cargo_name like concat('%', #{query.cargoName}, '%')
and bw_cargo.merge_code like concat('%', #{query.mergeCode}, '%')
and 1 = 2
and bw_cargo.id in
#{item}
order by merge_code

SELECT bw_cargo.id, bw_cargo.cargo_name AS material_name, bw_cargo.merge_code, bw_cargo.supplier, bw_cargo.producer, bw_inventory.unit_id, bw_cargo.specification, ifnull(SUM( bw_inventory.available_quantity ), 0) - ifnull(reserve.reserve_quantity, 0 ) AS inventory_quantity FROM bw_cargo LEFT JOIN bw_inventory_batch ON bw_cargo.id = bw_inventory_batch.cargo_id and bw_inventory_batch.available = 1 LEFT JOIN bw_inventory ON bw_inventory.inventory_batch_id = bw_inventory_batch.id LEFT JOIN (select bw_cargo.id as cargo_id, SUM(reserve_quantity) reserve_quantity from bw_cargo LEFT JOIN bw_inventory_reserve on bw_cargo.id = bw_inventory_reserve.cargo_id GROUP BY cargo_id ) as reserve on reserve.cargo_id = bw_cargo.id
AND bw_cargo.platform_material_id in
#{pId}
GROUP BY bw_cargo.id

select a.cargo_id, a.available_quantity, ifnull(b.reserve_quantity, 0) as reserve_quantity from (select sum(available_quantity) as available_quantity, cargo_id from bw_inventory group by cargo_id) a left join (select sum(reserve_quantity) as reserve_quantity, cargo_id from bw_inventory_reserve group by cargo_id) b on a.cargo_id = b.cargo_id

select a.inventory_batch_id, a.available_quantity, ifnull(b.reserve_quantity, 0) as reserve_quantity from (select sum(available_quantity) as available_quantity, inventory_batch_id from bw_inventory group by inventory_batch_id) a left join (select sum(reserve_quantity) as reserve_quantity, inventory_batch_id from bw_inventory_reserve group by inventory_batch_id) b on a.inventory_batch_id = b.inventory_batch_id
select ifnull(sum(available_quantity), 0) as available_quantity from bw_inventory where inventory_batch_id = #{inventoryBatchId}
